decisions.persistent_asset_identity: Every persistent physical asset gets a stable Asset_ID; low-value consumables may use batch/lot identity.
decisions.watchtower_ac: Keep source-lock baseline, analyse alternative A/C face exclusions, and require owner/professional promotion rather than automatic rebinding.
decisions.watchtower_robustness: Display symmetric and asymmetric candidates side-by-side; test cable loss x1/x2/x3 and physically-defined tower-damage sensitivity before selection.
decisions.watchtower_roof: Preserve planar FCStd substrate and use separately versioned shallow-curved Solar Hull/envelope overlay; retain wider analysis range without render-derived geometry.
decisions.resilience_energy_fuel: Add below-grade refuge/service volumes; evaluate central/distributed/hybrid Free Flow storage including Chain-Hill/service-corridor growth; fuel-energy separation is analysis/QRA output with secondary manual approval.
decisions.federated_nodes: Physical infrastructure follows Cognigrex architecture: autonomous node identity and minimum-safe function with mutual support, isolation, degraded and reunification states.
decisions.aviation: Retain as long-horizon earmarked reserve/interface; do not harden current block geometry around unconfirmed aviation requirements.
decisions.ecogrex: No fixed owner-selected ecological intensity. Eco-X/Eco-Grex collaboratively governs ecological integration from site/custodial/biosecurity/fire/water evidence and infrastructure constraints.
decisions.sensory_acoustic: Remove biofield as a required chamber/programme label; optimise measurable internal facades/surfaces/environment interactions. Pilot acoustic ecology early and expand longitudinal cross-domain baselines.
decisions.web4: COIN remains provenance/authority/evidence first; non-financial NFT/twin representations carry no implied title/IP/revenue/certification/mission rights. EMC2/LightSpeed Coin economic architecture may be prepared and backbenched but activation remains disabled until separate gates close.
decisions.pilot_ladder: Use multiple outcome-led pilots: interplanetary supply-chain/Australian-sovereignty flagship, SEQLD Eco-Grex deployment, modular DIY outreach, and terrestrial Solar Hull/Free Flow R&D. Success in one pilot should inform/unlock the next rather than enforce a single rigid phase chain.

guardrails: Owner decisions are not structural, regulatory, fire, electrical, ecological or launch-safety proof.
No fifth Watch Tower A/C anchor or automatic cable-edge promotion is created.
Tower-damage percentage requires a physically defined damaged region/mechanism; percentage alone is not a valid model.
Eco-X authority supersedes the provisional fixed HIGH ecological-integration default.
No therapeutic, clinical, healing-frequency or human-energy-field claim is created by environmental/acoustic/facade R&D.
No economic-token mint/transfer/custody/public activation is authorised.
